description: Reddit Campaign Planner’s forecast for a proposed campaign: the audience, projected reach, impressions, clicks, frequency and CPM/CPC/CPV for this budget, and a curve of reach at ten budgets to compare. Creates nothing and spends nothing. Use reddit_ads_forecast for a quick audience size. Reddit allows 30 of these a minute. These are Reddit’s estimates, not a guarantee, and they reserve nothing; say so, and keep each result beside the inputs that made it.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

bidAmount.description: bid in the ad account currency

bidStrategy.description: BIDLESS (Lowest Cost), MANUAL_BIDDING, TARGET_CPX (Target Cost) or MAXIMIZE_VOLUME. MAXIMIZE_VOLUME is Cost Cap: Reddit retires it on SALES/CONVERSIONS/LEAD_GENERATION/APP_INSTALLS/CATALOG_SALES from 2027-02-10; use TARGET_CPX or BIDLESS there

bidType.description: CPC, CPM, CPV, CPV6 or CPV15

budget.description: budget in the ad account’s currency (not micro-currency)

endTime.description: ISO 8601; default 30 days after the start, at most 365

goalType.description: whether budget is per day or for the whole plan

useCatalog.description: SALES objective: true forecasts catalog sales

name: reddit_ads_plan_forecast
title: Forecast a Reddit campaign plan
